programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Malaga - Racing 07.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Shadowlands
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Life in Dark WaterNew Zealand's dark fjords harbor creatures normally found in the deep; as winter approaches, bottlenose dolphins must escape their freezing fjord, while in a mountain river, a longfin eel heeds the call of the sea.

programme.title: Beasts of The Big Blue

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: Alex is happily married to a gynecologist, Tung for five years. When Alex is fatally wounded in an accident, he feels obliged to tell Tung about his affair with Blackie.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros' Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport vampires for a living. When two of them hopped away, it is revealed that one of them is actually a man in disguise trying to escape from his enemies.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: An award winning movie for best script and best editing. Another tale of a Sino-Japanese war that artistically and emotional triumphed, it clearly portrays the life of wartime.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan (Yi Lei) is a compulsive gambler. He makes his wife as a down payment for his debt, feeling regretted and decides to kill himself but stops when a beautiful ghost appears.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: A framed kung-fu master seeks revenge after 15 years in prison. He survives one attempt on his life after another! An intriguing, exciting production which weaves mystery and suspense with kung-fu action.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Another film inspired by the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. This memorable version presents a unique interpretation with humour, action, and fantasy galore.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: It's tale of brave knights, chivalry and fair maidens where the Swift Knight finds himself involved in romance, court intrigue and deadly jousts while trying to protect a baby who is the Emperor's secret heir apparent.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung who lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with his brothers the Black Snake and the Yellow Snake, have been trying to turn into humans for a thousand years.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: The patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: It's a no-holds-barred battle to the death for possession of the invaluable Purple Sword. Assistant director Wang Po-yi also wrote this entertaining and exciting adventure.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: The fabulous tale of a frostbitten swordswoman out to get her parents' murderers.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Several years before GHOSTBUSTERS was a massive Hollywood hit, Wong Jing scripted this hilarious supernatural action comedy starring Alexander Fu and directed by Lau Ka Wing.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2
programme.desc: War and time change everything. Their love becomes more than reunion, it becomes a reckoning with what was and what could've been.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: The Sung Dynasty army's Chief Instructor is on a danger-fraught pilgrimage to the Tung Yueh Temple.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Beloved cult director Kueh Chih Hung delivers this deranged romantic tragedy centring on muscular demon Lo Meng, whose attempts to possess the soul of his true love backfire.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: There is an old grudge between families among the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung. Some years later, Liang's son Hsiao-hu returns to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Humiliated swordsman Chin Wu-hsin is charged with finding the Supreme Sword of Old Eagle, only to retrieve it using foul play. This leads Old Eagle's own son to avenge his father.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng flees to San Francisco after he is framed for drug possession. He assists Philip Kwok's notorious White Dragons in a vicious gang war, only to then be betrayed.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Perennial martial-arts villain Shek Kin takes on a rare comedic role as a playful ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his feuding parents.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho portrays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senselessly wounded and her mother raped. 18 years later it's payback time.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei stars as a young singer, Hsiao-Yun, struggles between her success in career and her relationship with her pianist lover Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: A wealthy womanizer writes a diary about his romantic escapades, but the women with whom he’s been intimate have all been murdered.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and taking revenge.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: A dedicated wife uncovers a web of blackmail and deceit after her husband is conned by a conniving belly dancer. When the dancer is stabbed, things quickly go from bad to insane.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: The Monkey King and his gang are confronted by the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her two sexy sisters, plus a cast of fanciful characters.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: The story evolves around Lin Shao-teh, a poor student who was engaged to Chien-king, the daughter of billionaire Wang Chun.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and his fiance to help escort gold to the capital. The duo run into a mysterious knight along the way and prevent bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: When the Emperor is killed and the throne is usurped by Lord 9, his two baby princes are entrusted to the care of three Shaolin monks and the premier.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: A schizophrenic who refuses to believe her pilot lover was killed and believes his death to be a lie created to end their relationship.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master, he fights to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Police officer Chow Sing Sing is assigned to work undercover investigating the murder of millionaire Million Wong, to whom Chow has an uncanny resemblance, by posing as an amnesiac Wong.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: Son Donglu, a newly promoted detective teams up with Guo Zhui, fastest gunman in Tiancheng and Xiaowu, a novice policeman to investigate the mystery deaths in a bullet factory.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective suffers a fatal accident involving a mysterious medallion and is transformed into an immortal warrior with superhuman powers.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: In 1920s China, a bandit arrives in a remote provincial town posing as its new mayor, where he faces off against a tyrannical local nobleman.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Iceman (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Never Leave

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: Agent Jon contemplates leaving the force until he learns his brother is working as a mercenary for a former colleague who betrayed their team.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: A Chinese warlord hires a conjurer to help him impress a resistant concubine.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: Fri 20 Nov : Welcome To The Weekend
programme.desc: Light-hearted, inclusive and entertaining, Welcome to the Weekend is the show that kicks off the Premier League Weekend. We will focus on the football, but also on the lifestyle topics that footballers and fans love - food, fashion, music, movies and much, much more.

programme.title: Fri 20 Nov : Team Talks
programme.desc: Punditry, pressers and predictions ahead of the PL Weekend. Our studio team tackle all the major talking points, and we hear from the headlines acts as the players and the managers have their say ahead of the action.

programme.title: Fri 20 Nov : Fantasy Show
programme.desc: Haaland or Ekitike? Saka or Palmer? Cunha or Joao Pedro? Picking your Fantasy team is never easy, but the Fantasy Show is on hand to help FPL Managers with those big decisions.

programme.title: Alex Scott : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Alex Scott is the star that might never have been. Flying each weekend from his home island of Guernsey to Southampton's academy, Scott's love for the game was truly tested. His persistence in achieving his dream paid off though, and led to the start of a journey that now sees him as one of the Premier League's brightest young talents.

programme.title: Fri 20 Nov : Fanzone
programme.desc: This is the show that puts international fans at the heart of the Premier League conversation. We connect with fans from around the world as they share their views on their teams and favourite players.

programme.title: Fri 20 Nov : Preview
programme.desc: Anfield takes centre stage as Liverpool host Manchester United. We also preview Arsenal's trip to Newcastle and Manchester City taking on Fulham.

programme.title: (Subbed) Nemanja Matic : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Nemanja Matic's journey from his upbringing in Serbia to Premier League success with Chelsea and his time at Manchester United. He reflects on the experiences that shaped him, the challenges of establishing himself at the highest level and the managers who influenced his career. programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Inter Mediolan - Como 1907
programme.desc: Como przystępuje do spotkania z Interem opromienione zwycięstwem 9:1 nad Lens w Lidze Mistrzów. Przekonamy się, czy podopieczni Cesca Fabregasa wykażą się równie imponującą skutecznością przeciwko obrońcy scudetto.

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04
programme.desc: Barwy klubu FC Schalke 04 Gelsenkirchhen reprezentowało wielu klasowych snajperów, m.in. Klaus Fischer, Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Ebbe Sand, Kevin Kuranyi. W programie widzowie zobaczą najlepsze gole w historii drużyny z Gelsenkirchen.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Vitoria SC - FC Porto
programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: ACF Fiorentina - Juventus FC
programme.desc: Poprzednie ligowe spotkanie z Juventusem Fiorentina wygrała 2:0. Podrażnieni Bianconeri nie mogą pozwolić sobie powtórkę takiego rezultatu. Na obecnym etapie sezonu tracą już bowiem 11 punktów do lidera Serie A.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - ACF Fiorentina
programme.desc: AC Monza w poprzedniej kolejce musiała uznać wyższość Atalanty BC, przegrywając 0:1. Dla Biancorossich była to już czwarta ligowa porażka z rzędu. Przełamania będą teraz szukać w starciu z ACF Fiorentiną, choć zadanie nie wydaje się łatwe. Mimo że Fioletowi mieli w tym sezonie swoje problemy, ostatnio punktowali w trzech kolejnych spotkaniach, notując dwa remisy i zwycięstwo.

programme.desc: Overview of the best moments of the basketball Euroleague. Enjoy the performances of the best basketball players of the Old Continent, their incredible moves and turns that delighted the audience in the stands and in front of the small screens.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA League: San Antonio - LA Clippers
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA League, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: Handball - EHF Champions League: Kielce - Barca
programme.desc: The handball Champions League has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to the change of name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition, followed by eliminations, has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Zalgiris - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom to establish its own football league was Argentina. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: LaLiga Rookies
programme.desc: LaLiga Rookies je emisija posvećena upoznavanju mladih fudbalskih talenata koji su debitovali u španskoj profesionalnoj ligi. Kako se pronalaze talenti, kako se grade i kada su spremni da se vinu u superzvezdano fudbalsko nebo, saznajte iz epizode u epizodu ove interesantne emisije o Početnicima u LaLigi.

programme.title: Fudbal - Španska liga: Getafe - Atletico Madrid
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. Along with the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the highly technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Game plan
programme.desc: The football coach and analyst will talk about how football looks and how it should look, using the example of several games from the Premier League. We will try to focus on football itself, not to leave the football field, and to give an answer to the question of what separates the teams into those that lose and those that win, that is, they often win. Our guests, football experts, will also give their opinion.

programme.title: Fudbal - Mozzart Bet Superliga: IMT - Partizan
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and operates according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white team is more successful.

programme.title: Fudbal - Engleska liga: Liverpool - Manchester United
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for.

programme.title: PL Stories
programme.desc: The most exciting stories from the world of the English Premier League are brought to you by this sports magazine.

programme.title: Fudbal - Italijanska liga: Milan - Frosinone
programme.desc: Serie A is a professional football competition that consists of 20 teams in a two-round league championship. Ever since 1929, when it was founded, Serie A has become synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football was considered the best in Europe due to its quality and a number of great players and coaches.

programme.title: Fudbal - Nemačka liga: Werder Bremen - HSV
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings, until today. Don't miss every possible opportunity to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it.

programme.title: Fudbal - Francuska liga: Marseille - Le Mans
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the title of French champion. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the Greens have been waiting for a new title since 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game.
